120        
121        public void performDelivery(InteractionDialogAPI dialog) {
122                CampaignFleetAPI playerFleet = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
123                CargoAPI cargo = playerFleet.getCargo();
124                
125                cargo.removeItems(CargoItemType.RESOURCES, event.getCommodityId(), event.getQuantity());
126                cargo.getCredits().add(event.getReward() + event.getEscrow());
127                applyTradeValueImpact(event.getReward());
128                AddRemoveCommodity.addCommodityLossText(event.getCommodityId(), event.getQuantity(), dialog.getTextPanel());
129                if (event.getEscrow() > 0) {
130                        AddRemoveCommodity.addCreditsGainText(event.getEscrow(), dialog.getTextPanel());
131                }
132                AddRemoveCommodity.addCreditsGainText(event.getReward(), dialog.getTextPanel());
133                
134                float repAmount = 0.01f * event.getReward() / 10000f;
135                if (repAmount < 0.01f) repAmount = 0.01f;
136                if (repAmount > 0.05f) repAmount = 0.05f;
137                
138                MissionCompletionRep completionRep = new MissionCompletionRep(repAmount, RepLevel.COOPERATIVE, -repAmount, RepLevel.INHOSPITABLE);
139                
140                ReputationAdjustmentResult rep = null;
141                rep = Global.getSector().adjustPlayerReputation(
142                                new RepActionEnvelope(RepActions.MISSION_SUCCESS, completionRep,
143                                                null, dialog.getTextPanel(), true, true), 
144                                                getFactionForUIColors().getId());
145                
146                setMissionResult(new MissionResult(event.getReward() + event.getEscrow(), rep, null));
147                setMissionState(MissionState.COMPLETED);
148                endMission();
149                
150                ContactIntel.addPotentialContact(event.getPerson(), event.getMarket(), dialog.getTextPanel());
151        }
152        
153        public boolean hasEnough() {
154                CampaignFleetAPI playerFleet = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
155                CargoAPI cargo = playerFleet.getCargo();
156                
157                return cargo.getCommodityQuantity(event.getCommodityId()) >= event.getQuantity();
158        }

160        
161        protected void applyTradeValueImpact(float totalReward) {
162                FactionAPI faction = getFactionForUIColors();
163                MarketAPI market = event.getDestination();
164                
165                boolean illegal = market.isIllegal(event.getCommodityId());
166                
167                SubmarketAPI submarket = null;
168                for (SubmarketAPI curr : market.getSubmarketsCopy()) {
169                        if (!curr.getPlugin().isParticipatesInEconomy()) continue;
170                        
171                        if (illegal && curr.getPlugin().isBlackMarket()) {
172                                submarket = curr;
173                                break;
174                        }
175                        if (!illegal && curr.getPlugin().isOpenMarket()) {
176                                submarket = curr;
177                                break;
178                        }
179                }
180                
181                if (submarket == null) return;
182                
183                PlayerTradeDataForSubmarket tradeData = SharedData.getData().getPlayerActivityTracker().getPlayerTradeData(submarket);
184                CargoStackAPI stack = Global.getFactory().createCargoStack(CargoItemType.RESOURCES, event.getCommodityId(), null);
185                stack.setSize(event.getQuantity());
186                tradeData.addToTrackedPlayerSold(stack, totalReward);
187                
188                Misc.affectAvailabilityWithinReason(getCommodity(), (int) (event.getQuantity() * 0.25f));
189        }
190        
191        
192        public void endMission() {
193                if (event.getMarket() == null) {
194                        endAfterDelay();
195                        return; // to fix crash for saves that are already in a bad state
196                }
197                
198                Misc.makeUnimportant(event.getDestination().getPrimaryEntity(), "deliveryEvent");
199                
200                if (!event.getMarket().isPlayerOwned()) {
201                        if (isFailed() || isAbandoned()) {
202                                Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(
203                                                DeliveryBarEvent.KEY_FAILED_RECENTLY, true, 
204                                                DeliveryBarEvent.FAILED_RECENTLY_DURATION * (0.75f + (float) Math.random() * 0.5f));
205                                
206                                float p = PROB_CONSEQUENCES;
207                                if (event.getEscrow() > 0) {
208                                        p = PROB_CONSEQUENCES_ESCROW;
209                                }
210                                if ((float) Math.random() < p || DebugFlags.BAR_DEBUG) {
211                                        Global.getSector().addScript(new DeliveryFailureConsequences(this));
212                                }
213                        }
214                }
215                endAfterDelay();
216        }

222        protected void addBulletPoints(TooltipMakerAPI info, ListInfoMode mode) {
223                
224                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
225                Color g = Misc.getGrayColor();
226                float pad = 3f;
227                float opad = 10f;
228                
229                float initPad = pad;
230                if (mode == ListInfoMode.IN_DESC) initPad = opad;
231                
232                Color tc = getBulletColorForMode(mode);
233                
234                bullet(info);
235                boolean isUpdate = getListInfoParam() != null;
236                
237                FactionAPI faction = getFactionForUIColors();
238                if (isUpdate) {
239                        // 3 possible updates: de-posted/expired, failed, completed
240                        if (isFailed() || isCancelled()) {
241                                return;
242                        } else if (isCompleted() && missionResult != null) {
243                                if (missionResult.payment > 0) {
244                                        info.addPara("%s received", initPad, tc, h, Misc.getDGSCredits(missionResult.payment));
245                                }
246                                
247                                if (missionResult.rep1 != null && missionResult.rep1.delta != 0) {
248                                        CoreReputationPlugin.addAdjustmentMessage(missionResult.rep1.delta, faction, null, 
249                                                                                                                  null, null, info, tc, isUpdate, 0f);
250                                }
251                        }
252                } else {
253                        // either in small description, or in tooltip/intel list
254                        if (missionResult != null) {
255                                if (missionResult.payment > 0) {
256                                        info.addPara("%s received", initPad, tc, h, Misc.getDGSCredits(missionResult.payment));
257                                        initPad = 0f;
258                                }
259                                
260                                if (missionResult.rep1 != null && missionResult.rep1.delta != 0) {
261                                        CoreReputationPlugin.addAdjustmentMessage(missionResult.rep1.delta, faction, null, 
262                                                                                                          null, null, info, tc, isUpdate, initPad);
263                                        initPad = 0f;
264                                }
265                        } else {
266                                if (mode != ListInfoMode.IN_DESC) {
267                                        info.addPara("Faction: " + faction.getDisplayName(), initPad, tc,
268                                                                                                 faction.getBaseUIColor(),
269                                                                                                 faction.getDisplayName());
270                                        initPad = 0f;
271                                }
272                                
273                                LabelAPI label = info.addPara("%s units to " + event.getDestination().getName(), 
274                                                         initPad, tc, h, "" + (int) event.getQuantity());
275                                label.setHighlight("" + event.getQuantity(), event.getDestination().getName());
276                                label.setHighlightColors(h, event.getDestination().getFaction().getBaseUIColor());
277                                info.addPara("%s reward", 0f, tc, h, Misc.getDGSCredits(event.getReward()));
278                                if (event.getEscrow() > 0) {
279                                        info.addPara("%s held in escrow", 0f, tc, h, Misc.getDGSCredits(event.getEscrow()));
280                                }
281                                addDays(info, "to complete", duration - elapsedDays, tc, 0f);
282                        }
283                }
284                
285                unindent(info);
286        }

327        @Override
328        public void createSmallDescription(TooltipMakerAPI info, float width, float height) {
329                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
330                Color g = Misc.getGrayColor();
331                Color tc = Misc.getTextColor();
332                float pad = 3f;
333                float opad = 10f;
334
335                FactionAPI faction = getFactionForUIColors();
336                
337                boolean illegal = event.getDestination().isIllegal(event.getCommodityId());
338                
339                //info.addImage(commodity.getCommodity().getIconName(), width, 80, opad);
340                
341                CommodityOnMarketAPI com = getCommodity();
342                MarketAPI market = event.getDestination();
343                
344                info.addImages(width, 80, opad, opad * 2f,
345                                           com.getCommodity().getIconName(),
346                                           faction.getCrest(),
347                                           market.getFaction().getCrest());
348
349                
350                String post = "";
351                if (Factions.PIRATES.equals(faction.getId())) {
352                        post = "-affiliated";
353                }
354                
355                //String desc = event.getPersonDesc();
356                String start = "You've";
357                if (!isPosted() && !isAccepted()) start = "You had";
358                
359                if (event.getMarket() == null) {
360                        return;
361                }
362                LabelAPI label = info.addPara(start + " accepted " + faction.getPersonNamePrefixAOrAn() + " " + 
363                                faction.getPersonNamePrefix() + post + " contract to deliver a quantity of " +
364                                com.getCommodity().getLowerCaseName() + 
365                                " from " + event.getMarket().getName() + " to " + market.getName() + ", " +
366                                                "which is under " + market.getFaction().getPersonNamePrefix() + " control.", opad,
367                                faction.getBaseUIColor(), faction.getPersonNamePrefix() + post);
368                
369                label.setHighlight(faction.getPersonNamePrefix() + post, market.getFaction().getPersonNamePrefix());
370                label.setHighlightColors(faction.getBaseUIColor(), market.getFaction().getBaseUIColor());
371                
372                if (isPosted() || isAccepted()) {
373                        addBulletPoints(info, ListInfoMode.IN_DESC);
374                        
375                        info.addPara("To make the delivery, either dock at " + market.getName() + " openly or approach it without " +
376                                                 "attracting the attention of nearby patrols.", opad);
377                        
378//                      if (illegal) {
379//                              info.addPara("The legality of the delivery is at best questionable and " +
380//                                              "it must be made with the transponder turned off.", opad);
381//                      } else {
382//                              info.addPara("The contract is above-board and the delivery may be made openly.", opad);
383//                      }
384                        
385                        //addGenericMissionState(info);
386                        addAcceptOrAbandonButton(info, width);
387                } else {
388                        if (isFailed() && !market.isInEconomy()) {
389                                info.addPara("You have failed this contract because " + market.getName() + 
390                                                     " no longer exists as a functional polity.", opad);        
391                        } else {
392                                addGenericMissionState(info);
393                        }
394                        
395                        addBulletPoints(info, ListInfoMode.IN_DESC);
396                }
397
398        }

425        @Override
426        protected MissionResult createAbandonedResult(boolean withPenalty) {
427                if (withPenalty) {
428                        float repAmount = 0.01f * event.getReward() / 10000f;
429                        if (repAmount < 0.01f) repAmount = 0.01f;
430                        if (repAmount > 0.05f) repAmount = 0.05f;
431                        
432                        MissionCompletionRep completionRep = new MissionCompletionRep(repAmount, RepLevel.WELCOMING, -repAmount, RepLevel.INHOSPITABLE);
433                        
434                        ReputationAdjustmentResult rep = Global.getSector().adjustPlayerReputation(
435                                        new RepActionEnvelope(RepActions.MISSION_FAILURE, completionRep,
436                                                                                  null, null, true, false),
437                                                                                  getFactionForUIColors().getId());
438                        
439                        return new MissionResult(0, rep, null);
440                }
441                return new MissionResult();
442        }
